title: With a deposit held, Change Customer that would move the Bill To is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer D, the new customer, that bills itself.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, that bills itself, holding a $10.00 deposit taken under customer A.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click Change Customer (the two arrows at the top right of the Customer card).
  4. Pick customer D.
  5. Confirm the change.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".

Step 3:

  • The Change Customer button is enabled and the customer picker opens.

Step 4:

  • Customer D is picked.

Step 5:

  • The change is refused with the deposit refusal shown today for Change Customer.
  • The work order's customer is still customer A.
  • "Bill To" still reads "This customer".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12308 (Story 6, Change Customer with a Bill To)

  • S6-R3: “The existing deposit block on Change Customer applies only when the change would change the Bill To.”
  • Feature Overview, State by action (Action | Open | Invoiced | Internal or No Charge): “Change Customer | Allowed. A default Bill To follows, a picked one stays. Deposits block only if the Bill To would change. | As today; the invoice keeps its Bill To. A self-billed document stays self-billed. | As the Internal Work Orders PRD”
